row.team_price_text: Starter: $29/mo billed yearly, up to 2 admin users
row.evidence: Swell's help centre says dashboard users are added with the 'Invite user' button under Settings → Users, and neither the pricing page, help centre nor developer docs mention SSO, SAML or SCIM.
row.notes: None by absence. Flat per-store pricing billed yearly (Starter $29, Basic $79, Standard $299, Unlimited $2250/mo) with admin-user caps of 2/5/15/unlimited; Custom via sales. Role-based permissions only on Unlimited and Enterprise. No SSO documented. Backend API manages store data and customer accounts, not dashboard users. Not in the Okta Integration Network.

plans.price_text: $29 / month, billed yearly (up to 2 admin users)

plans.price_text: $79 / month, billed yearly (up to 5 admin users)

plans.name: Standard
plans.price_text: $299 / month, billed yearly (up to 15 admin users)

scim.notes: No SCIM, SAML or SSO mention on the pricing page, help centre or the full developer docs (llms-full.txt).

rate_limits.text: Backend API rate limited per store and environment; figures depend on plan.

limitations.text: Backend API accounts are customer accounts, not dashboard users.

user_api.notes: The Backend API (Basic auth with store ID + secret key) manages store data; its "accounts" are storefront customers. No endpoints for dashboard admin users were found.

fallbacks.notes: Dashboard users are invited manually under Settings > Users.

searched: https://www.swell.is/sitemap-0.xml (help centre: users, privacy and security)
https://developers.swell.is/llms.txt and https://developers.swell.is/llms-full.txt (full Backend/Frontend API docs: no SCIM, SAML or SSO)
open_questions: Whether the Custom/Enterprise plan offers SSO is not documented.
No API for managing dashboard admin users is documented.
